description: NXP i.MX RT1062 (Cortex-M7 600 MHz, double-precision FPU; no radio)
cflags_note: The same CPU and float ABI as Teensyduino's build of Baseline.
ldflags_note: Code and rodata share one address window, so the sketch's one flash segment is RWX by design.
libs_note: No ROM C library on this chip: newlib supplies memcpy, strlen, ... (the SDK's malloc/printf come first).
defines_note: Not ARDUINO_ARCH_ESP32 or TEENSYDUINO: libraries would pick code paths for a core the SDK does not have. __IMXRT1062__ for imxrt.h, which sketches may include (Teensy's core folder is last on the include path).
stop_detect_note: Baseline parks a sketch spinning in an empty while(1) instead of letting the watchdog roll it back (flick test step 4).
ci_note: CI builds in Espressif's ESP-IDF image, which has no Teensyduino: baseline.yml and build_examples.py --out leave these targets out until a job installs it.
